description: Phase 9+10+11: Frontend implementation - API types, API module, actions, reducer, all UI components (group list, create/edit, timeline, members, reports), navigation/routing integration, notification rendering, and frontend i18n (en + ko).
steps: Create app/javascript/mastodon/api_types/occm_groups.ts - Define ApiOccmGroupJSON, ApiOccmGroupMembershipJSON, ApiOccmGroupReportJSON interfaces with proper TypeScript types

Create app/javascript/mastodon/api/occm_groups.ts - All API functions following api/lists.ts pattern: apiGetOccmGroups, apiGetOccmGroup, apiCreateOccmGroup, apiUpdateOccmGroup, apiDeleteOccmGroup, apiGetOccmGroupMembers, apiGetOccmGroupPendingMembers, apiJoinOccmGroup, apiApproveOccmGroupMember, apiRejectOccmGroupMember, apiRemoveOccmGroupMember, apiTransferOccmGroupAdmin, apiPromoteOccmGroupModerator, apiDemoteOccmGroupModerator, apiGetOccmGroupTimeline, apiPostToOccmGroup, apiGetOccmGroupReports, apiCreateOccmGroupReport, apiResolveOccmGroupReport, apiDeleteOccmGroupStatus

Create app/javascript/mastodon/actions/occm_groups.ts - Action type constants (FETCH/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE with REQUEST/SUCCESS/FAIL, MEMBERS_FETCH, JOIN, LEAVE, TIMELINE_EXPAND) and thunk action creators that call API module functions and dispatch appropriate actions

Create app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/occm_groups.ts - Reducer following lists.ts pattern using ImmutableMap, handles all action types, state shape: items Map<string, OccmGroup>, isLoading boolean, loaded boolean
Modify app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/index.ts - Import and register occmGroups reducer in the reducers object

Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/occm_groups/index.tsx - Group list screen using Column, ColumnHeader, ScrollableList pattern from features/lists/index.tsx. Shows group items with title, member count, role badge. New Group button in header
Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/occm_groups/components/occm_group_item.tsx - Individual group list item component with title, member count, role badge, link to group timeline

Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/occm_groups/new.tsx - Create/Edit group form following features/lists/new.tsx pattern. Title input (max 100), description textarea (max 500), approval_required toggle, submit button

Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/occm_group_timeline/index.tsx - Group timeline using StatusListContainer pattern from list_timeline/index.jsx. Connects streaming via connectOccmGroupStream on mount, disconnects on unmount. ColumnHeader with group title and action buttons (settings, members). Supports infinite scroll pagination

Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/occm_groups/members.tsx - Members screen with Active/Pending tabs. Active tab shows members with role badges and admin actions (remove, promote/demote). Pending tab shows approve/reject buttons. Uses ScrollableList

Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/occm_groups/reports.tsx - Reports screen for admin/mod. Open/Resolved tabs. Each report shows reporter, target, category, comment. Resolve button with action selection (dismiss, delete_posts, remove_member)
Modify app/javascript/mastodon/features/ui/util/async-components.js - Add async component imports for OccmGroups, OccmGroupNew, OccmGroupTimeline, OccmGroupMembers, OccmGroupReports
Add navigation link for Groups in the sidebar navigation component (find the component that renders Lists link and add Groups link nearby with appropriate icon)

Add notification rendering for 4 OCCM group notification types in the notifications feature - add cases in the notification rendering switch for occm_group_join_request, occm_group_join_approved, occm_group_join_rejected, occm_group_post_deleted with appropriate text, icons, and navigation

Add all occm_groups.* keys to app/javascript/mastodon/locales/en.json - title, create, edit, delete, join, leave, pending, members, pending_members, reports, approve, reject, remove_member, promote_mod, demote_mod, transfer_admin, timeline, post, approval_required, description, group_title, confirm_delete, member_count (with ICU plural)
Add all occm_groups.* keys to app/javascript/mastodon/locales/ko.json - Korean translations matching en.json structure
acceptance_criteria: API module exports all required functions with correct paths and types
Redux actions dispatch correctly (REQUEST on start, SUCCESS/FAIL on completion)
Reducer properly updates state for all action types
Group list screen renders with Column/ColumnHeader/ScrollableList pattern
Create/edit form handles validation and submission
Timeline connects to streaming and displays statuses
Members screen shows active/pending tabs with appropriate actions per role
Reports screen is accessible only to admin/moderators
All routes resolve to correct components
All i18n keys present in both en.json and ko.json
verification: Run: npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compiles without errors
Verify all locale keys are present in both en.json and ko.json files
